alternate_grids.provenance: The torch dump this case carried before Task 2 pinned the dumper's thread pool and demanded deterministic algorithms. Pinning moved exactly one of the grid's 400 int32 slots -- flat index 358, codebook 7 of 8, frame 8 of 50 -- from 1004 to 237; this port's free run reproduces the pre-pinning grid on all 400 slots. Two reference configurations therefore straddle one decision whose guided log-probabilities differ by 6.87e-05, about 9x below the 6.1e-04 F32 logit divergence slice 4 measured between port and oracle, so which side is taken is not a quantity this arithmetic resolves. Admitted as a second exact target by jiangzhuo's ruling of 2026-07-31. Not regenerable: the ambient thread configuration that produced it was never pinned, which is why the bytes are committed rather than a recipe for them.
